PLANESWALKER-THE_PLANESWALKER.title: The Planeswalker
PLANESWALKER-THE_PLANESWALKER.descriptio:
A mage whose spark lets them walk between worlds.
Cards gain colored mana that lasts all combat; spend it to fuel each color's finisher.
PLANESWALKER-THE_PLANESWALKER.aromaPrinc: [sine][gold]Mana flows through every plane. Even this one.[/gold][/sine]
PLANESWALKER-THE_PLANESWALKER.bestiaryQu: I have not yet dealt with this creature.
PLANESWALKER-THE_PLANESWALKER.cardsModif: Planeswalker cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
PLANESWALKER-THE_PLANESWALKER.eventDeath: My spark will not go out here.
PLANESWALKER-THE_PLANESWALKER.goldMonolo: [sine]Enough to buy a few more spells...[/sine]
PLANESWALKER-THE_PLANESWALKER.unlockText: Play a single run with [pink]{Prerequisite}[/pink] to unlock this character.
